q1_our_formula_vs_SI_printed_string._compares: the structure the corpus stores for 6A1-SC8, against the formula STRING printed in the Fig S1 caption

q2_SI_string_vs_SI_printed_calc._compares: the SI's OWN formula string against the SI's OWN printed 'Calc.' m/z -- an internal consistency check on the caption, in which we take no part
q2_SI_string_vs_SI_printed_calc.tol_why: the caption prints 2 decimals, so |delta| <= 0.005 is pure rounding and anything larger is a real disagreement

q3_our_formula_vs_SI_printed_found._compares: our monoisotopic mass against the SI's printed 'found' value, which is a DECONVOLUTED neutral mass, not an observed m/z (see q4)
q3_our_formula_vs_SI_printed_found.tol_why: the caption prints 1 decimal for 'found', so the printed value itself carries +/-0.05 Da of quantisation

q4_our_formula_vs_the_labels_DRAWN_in_Fi._compares: our formula's predicted [M+2H]2+ isotope ladder against the m/z labels printed inside the spectrum itself. The caption plays no part in this check.
q4_our_formula_vs_the_labels_DRAWN_in_Fi.labels_read_from: embedded raster in SI p.4, read by eye at 900 dpi
q4_our_formula_vs_the_labels_DRAWN_in_Fi.charge_state_note: z=2 is derived from the 0.5 Da spacing. The caption's '2170.3 Da found' is therefore a deconvoluted neutral mass; no 2170 ion was observed.

q5_nmr_ppm_axis._compares: nothing yet -- this is the calibration the integral assignment in q6 rests on
q5_nmr_ppm_axis.excluded: the two outermost labels, clipped by the panel frame, so their glyph centroids are not on their ticks
q5_nmr_ppm_axis.caveat: these are text-layer LABEL centroids, not detected tick marks. A label typeset off its tick is error class 20; the LOO residuals below are what would expose it.

q6_nmr_integral_ratios._compares: integral RATIOS against the corpus structure's own H counts. Ratios, not absolute integrals: the 0.87 ppm methyl is the spectrum's reference and is set to 18.00 by the operator, so comparing it to 18 is circular and is NOT counted as a check.
q6_nmr_integral_ratios.what_it_cannot_see: arm REGIOCHEMISTRY. The ratios fix one glycol diester and one octyl thioether per arm; they are blind to which core nitrogen each arm is on.
